北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京-2℃体感-6℃，注意保暖防寒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing -2℃, feels like -6℃. Stay warm and protect against cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天3℃体感-3℃，风大天冷多添衣。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy 3℃, feels like -3℃. It's windy and cold, wear more layers.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天2℃体感-1℃，出门别忘了加件外套哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai 2℃, feels like -1℃. Don't forget an extra coat when you go out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州17℃体感13℃，早晚温差大，注意添减衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou 17℃, feels like 13℃. Big temperature swing, dress accordingly.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云17℃，体感舒适，湿度较高，注意通风。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen 17℃, feels comfortable. High humidity, ensure ventilation.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天2℃体感-3℃，湿冷体感明显，注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou 2℃, feels like -3℃. Damp and cold, please stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴天1℃体感-2℃，气温低，小心着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing 1℃, feels like -2℃. It's cold, be careful not to catch a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天8℃体感4℃，体感稍凉，出门记得带伞。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu 8℃, feels like 4℃. A bit cool, remember to bring an umbrella.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴天4℃体感-1℃，白天虽然晴朗，仍需注意保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan 4℃, feels like -1℃. Sunny but still chilly, remember to stay warm.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴天4℃体感1℃，湿度低较干燥，记得多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an 4℃, feels like 1℃. Low humidity and dry, remember to drink more water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾10℃体感6℃，能见度低，出行请注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy 10℃, feels like 6℃. Low visibility, please travel safely.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨-21℃体感-27℃，极寒天气，务必做好全面防寒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin -21℃, feels like -27℃. Extreme cold, be sure to keep fully warm.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -27℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳-16℃体感-21℃，天寒地冻，注意防冻伤。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang -16℃, feels like -21℃. Freezing cold, beware of frostbite.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天14℃体感9℃，昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming 14℃, feels like 9℃. Large day-night temperature difference, dress warmly in mornings and evenings.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天11℃体感8℃，风力较大，注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen 11℃, feels like 8℃. It's windy, remember to protect from wind and stay warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛-4℃体感-14℃，风力强劲，体感冰冷，全副武装！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao -4℃, feels like -14℃. Strong winds, feels icy cold, bundle up completely!
青岛.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连-10℃体感-17℃，风大天冷，谨防感冒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian -10℃, feels like -17℃. Windy and cold, beware of catching a cold.
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃
